title: The Noise at Two

pre.en: What was really making the noise at night?
pre.zh: 夜里的声音到底是什么发出来的？

intro: 一篇新概念式的小故事：先交代背景（刚搬家、在家办公、睡得早），再出一件怪事（凌晨两点的噪音），最后揭晓真相、轻松收尾。读的时候留意时态：讲习惯和这段时间的状态用一般现在时和现在进行时，讲那一周发生的事用一般过去时。

sentences.en: So, I moved in three weeks ago, and I'm still getting used to the new flat.
sentences.zh: 我是三周前搬进来的，到现在还在适应新家。

sentences.en: My flatmate's away this month and I'm working from home, so it's really quiet.
sentences.zh: 室友这个月不在，我又在家办公，所以家里特别安静。

sentences.en: I usually go to bed at eleven and fall asleep in minutes.
sentences.zh: 我一般十一点上床，几分钟就睡着了。

sentences.en: Then on Monday morning, I found a note under my door.
sentences.zh: 结果周一早上，我在门缝底下发现了一张字条。

sentences.en: It was from Mrs Wang, the lady downstairs.
sentences.zh: 是楼下的王太太写的。

sentences.en: "Dear Chen," it said, "someone in your flat moves furniture around at two o'clock every night.
sentences.zh: 「小陈，」字条上写着，「你家每天夜里两点都有人在挪家具。

sentences.en: I'm not sleeping well these days.
sentences.zh: 我这些天一直睡不好。

sentences.en: Please stop."
sentences.zh: 请别再挪了。」

sentences.en: Honestly, it didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 说真的，我完全摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: At two in the morning, I'm always fast asleep.
sentences.zh: 凌晨两点，我早就睡得死死的了。

sentences.en: So I went downstairs and said, "I'm really sorry, but whatever it is, I'm not doing it on purpose."
sentences.zh: 于是我下楼跟她说：「真的很抱歉，可不管是什么动静，我都不是故意的。」

sentences.en: She didn't look sure.
sentences.zh: 她看上去将信将疑。

sentences.en: That night, I stayed awake to check.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我硬撑着没睡，想看个究竟。

sentences.en: At exactly two o'clock, I heard a soft hum in the living room.
sentences.zh: 两点整，客厅里传来一阵轻轻的嗡嗡声。

sentences.en: I walked in really slowly, and it turned out to be my new robot vacuum.
sentences.zh: 我轻手轻脚地走进去，结果发现是我新买的扫地机器人。

sentences.en: There it was, bumping into the sofa in the dark and cleaning a floor that was already clean.
sentences.zh: 它就在那儿，黑灯瞎火地一下下撞着沙发，扫着本来就干干净净的地板。

sentences.en: When I set it up, I chose 2:00 and didn't notice the little "a.m."
sentences.zh: 原来我设置的时候选了 2:00，没注意到后面那个小小的「a.m.」（凌晨）。

sentences.en: The next day, I changed the time and left a box of biscuits outside Mrs Wang's door, with a note.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我改好了时间，在王太太门口放了一盒饼干，还留了张字条。

sentences.en: "So sorry about the noise," I wrote.
sentences.zh: 「真不好意思，吵到您了，」我写道。

sentences.en: "My vacuum works night shifts."
sentences.zh: 「我的扫地机器人上的是夜班。」

sentences.en: The next morning, there was a new note under my door.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我门缝底下又多了一张字条。

sentences.en: "No problem," it said.
sentences.zh: 「没事儿，」上面写着。

sentences.en: "My husband snores louder."
sentences.zh: 「我老公打呼噜比它还响。」

cards.note: to start living in a new home
cards.tip: move in 后面不直接跟地点；要说搬进哪里用 move into：move into a new flat。搬走是 move out。
cards.example: We're moving in next Saturday, so the flat is full of boxes.

cards.note: to become familiar with something new so that it no longer feels strange
cards.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing：get used to living alone，不说 get used to live。
cards.example: It took me a month to get used to working from home.

cards.tip: fall asleep 说的是「睡着」这一下的变化；go to bed 只是「上床」。过去式 fell asleep。
cards.example: I fell asleep on the sofa in the middle of the film.

cards.note: to have a clear meaning that is easy to understand
cards.tip: 「我看不懂」可以说 It doesn't make sense to me，用 to 不用 for；make sense of sth 是「弄懂某事」。
cards.example: Your plan makes sense, but it will take a lot of time.

cards.note: 这里的 fast 不是「快」，而是「牢牢地」；同样意思还可以说 sound asleep。
because you want to, not by accident
cards.tip: 反义说法是 by accident / by mistake（无意中）；放在句末最自然。
cards.example: Sorry, I didn't delete your file on purpose.

cards.note: 机器、冰箱、蜜蜂发出的低沉而持续的声音；也能当动词：The fridge is humming.
to happen in a way you did not expect, or to be discovered to be true
cards.tip: 两种常见用法：It turned out (that) + 句子；sth turned out to be + 名词或形容词。
cards.example: The meeting turned out to be much shorter than I expected.

cards.note: vacuum cleaner 的简称，robot vacuum 就是扫地机器人；当动词是「用吸尘器吸」：vacuum the floor。
bump into sth 撞到东西；bump into sb 还可以表示「碰巧遇见某人」。
to write a short message and put it somewhere for someone to find
cards.tip: leave 的过去式是 left；「给某人留言」也可以说 leave sb a note。
cards.example: If I'm not home, just leave a note under the door.

cards.note: night shift 夜班，day shift 白班；work shifts 倒班工作。
名词也是 snore；snore loudly 呼噜打得很响。
